## Checklist
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `dart format`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, and Kotlin tests + lint pass
- [ ] Tests added/updated (rule-engine changes cover midnight / clock change / reboot)
- [ ] **No network**: no INTERNET permission, no network/analytics/ads packages
- [ ] **New permission?** If so: explained in PRIVACY.md + in-app prominent disclosure + described here
- [ ] **Original work**: no code, text, icons, layouts or assets copied from other apps; new assets listed in NOTICE with a compatible license
- [ ] UI uses design-system tokens; semantic labels; ≥ 48 dp touch targets
- [ ] Strict mode still has a working emergency unlock
- [ ] Docs updated (FEATURES.md / todo.md / ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [ ] Security, privacy and edge-case review: no Critical/High findings
